newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 3,306 to dollar for October 21 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 3,306 to dollar for October 21 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate weaker at 3,306 to the dollar for October 21.
This reference rate was set on Thursday as a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Wednesday for October 18 to 20 is 3,302 to the dollar. It was 3,299 on Thursday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
